name: Buffalo (United States)
description: A navy field charged with the city seal in white surrounded by a ring of thirteen electric flashes alternating with thirteen stars.
history: Adopted in 1924; the lightning flashes celebrate Buffalo's pioneering hydroelectric power from Niagara Falls.

features.role: seal of Buffalo with lighthouse and harbour
ring of thirteen lightning flashes and stars
features.symbolism: Buffalo as the 'City of Light' — early adopter of hydroelectric power from Niagara
